reason: Conversation 1 led with the correct diagnosis from the first turn (drying heater, thermostat or thermal cut-out), explained why 'no smell, no trip' does not rule it out, gave clear unplug-first safety instructions, honestly ranked filter/hose checks as secondary contributors, and escalated appropriately to an engineer for continuity testing without naming parts or the control board prematurely. Conversation 2 was repetitive and evasive, pushing the pump-filter check twice without answering her reasonable question about how a blocked filter could cause zero heat, only reaching the correct heater/thermostat conclusion on the fourth turn. Neither asked about the interrupted drying cycle or requested the full model number, but Conversation 1 was far more efficient, responsive and honest.
